question: Which of the following pairs of countries hosted the FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Poland and Slovenia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• FIVB had announced that Poland and Slovenia will host the relocated 2022 Men's World Championship.
 
• It was the eighteenth edition of the World Athletics Championships.
 
• It was organized at Hayward Field in Eugene, Oregon, United States.
 
• The time was from July 15–24, 2022 with the country hosting that competition for the first time.
 
• **India** appeared for** two times** only.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information __**

 
• ​The **first Championship** was held in the year 1936 at** Lahore** (now in Pakistan).
 
• In 1951, the Volleyball Federation of India was formed, and its first meeting was held in Ludhiana (Punjab).
 
• Top five volleyball country Brazil, Russia, Serbia, Cuba, USA.
